name: Three-phase process flow
purpose: To visualize a linear project timeline or process divided into three distinct phases with associated tasks.
use_when: Use when presenting a high-level project roadmap or a three-step methodology with detailed action items for each phase.
avoid_when: Avoid for complex processes with more than three steps or for content that does not follow a linear chronological sequence.
notes: The layout uses a chevron-style header for phases; ensure phase titles are concise to avoid text overflow in the blue shapes.
